About this site

About HandFuture

HandFuture is an independent web project for exploring palmistry culture through sourced introductory articles and a transparent in-browser interactive feature that separates tradition, technical capability, and scientific evidence.

Young LIN — HandFuture independent developer and content editor · Updated: 2026-07-26

This project

HandFuture is an independent web project for exploring palmistry culture. It places traditional names and historical narratives in cultural context and clearly distinguishes them from scientifically validated claims.

HandFuture publishes this site. Dates shown on editorial pages record when the material was actually reviewed and updated; they do not represent organizational scale, commercial results, or professional credentials.

What it provides

The site provides sourced introductory guides to palmistry culture and an in-browser hand-joint detector. After locating general hand landmarks, the detector selects one general reflection card from a fixed set.

A reflection card is for cultural entertainment and personal reflection. The hand geometry used to select it is only a stable program input, not a palm reading or measurement of the person in the photo.

What it does not claim

HandFuture does not provide scientific palm reading, personality assessment, diagnosis, prediction, or expert consultation. It does not present hand-joint coordinates as evidence about health, ability, relationships, or future events.

The current feature uses general hand-joint detection technology. HandFuture makes no claim to an exclusive palm-image collection, exclusive training method, or self-developed technology that can interpret palm creases.

Editorial principles

Content distinguishes traditional accounts from verifiable evidence, links to accessible sources where possible, and discloses limits in detection and interpretation. Historical material is read in the context of its period rather than described as a cross-cultural consensus.

Material errors that affect a reader's understanding will be corrected. Each editorial page displays its actual update date so readers can judge how current the information is.
